2025 in games, manga, and merge conflicts

The annual wrap-up, in list form because it’s December 30th and I’m tired.

Games: 23 finished, 41 acquired. The backlog grows like a well-watered garden. Game of the year was Hades II, which is also game of next year at the rate I’m replaying it.

Manga: kept up with exactly two ongoing series and binged eleven finished ones. Finished series supremacy — no waiting, no cancellation anxiety.

Code: 1,204 commits, of which an embarrassing percentage were to my dotfiles. Two projects shipped, four projects “resting.” The RSS reader migration is planned for next year, which past me should know is a trap.

See you in 2026. (⌐■_■)
